notes.title: New VR Adventure Game Release!
notes.notes:
Hello VR Fans,

We’re excited to share our new adventure game, Tomb Explorer VR! If you're interested in this exciting VR title, mark your calendars for the August 1 release. Check out our trailer, screenshots below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/0b9808660bde17c78d0da579bfb9f53afa48b5f5.jpg[/img]

[b]TOMB EXPLORER VR[/b]

Tomb Explorer VR is an adventure game where you navigate/explore ancient ruins and tombs in search of historical treasures, relics and artifacts.

Features:
In a fully immersive physical virtual reality experience, you will need to utilize various physical movements such as walking, crouching, jumping, climbing, dodging, sliding, rope zip lining, and even using a whip to hang over ledges to navigate through each unique environment. The ultimate goal is to solve puzzles, unlock ancient mechanisms, avoid dangerous traps, and discover hidden passages to obtain valuable artifacts located all around the globe.

Experience real-life physical interactions in VR, using your hands, body movement, and weapons to crouch, jump, climb and navigate through different environments. Overcome various ancient traps that hinder you from completing your objective. Use your problem-solving skills to solve puzzles and explore new areas. Each unique environment comes with a historical background story.

notes.title: Dive into Darkness: 'The Descent' Unveiled
notes.notes:
Hello Horror Fans,

We trust you've relished numerous years of Halloween thrills with our Sinister Halloween Game. Today, we're excited to introduce our latest horror endeavor, 'The Descent.' Drawing inspiration from the unique walking experiences and jump scares of Sinister Halloween, this new game promises an array of chilling and distinctive horrors. As fellow horror enthusiasts, we believe you'll find great delight in this newest addition to our collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/d115195b878c7564865c48d19a99362f19a14ea7.jpg[/img]

[b]THE DESCENT[/b]

Experience 'The Descent,' a first-person psychological horror walking sim, set in the late 19th century in the coal mining town of Rockwell Mine. Immerse yourself in the grueling atmosphere of a miners environment and their unsettling encounters deep within the treacherous mines. Assume the role of an investigator who returns to this hometown after journalism school to unveil its mysteries.

Rockwell Mine has been plagued by numerous accidents, disappearances, and unexplained deaths, leaving authorities baffled. Despite countless investigations, the truth remains elusive, leading to the closure of the mine.

As a player, you must navigate the perilous mine, document your investigation with a camera, solve the mysteries behind the disappearances, and overcome obstacles while evading the dangers lurking within.

Features:
Genre: Walking Simulator
Explore room-to-room, observing evolving events.
Experience the challenges faced by miners.
Uncover the untold story of the mine.
Single Player Horror Game

notes.title: Asylum DLC Development Update 1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Asylum Development Progress Updates.
Today we reveal some media and the story behind the Asylum DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/618f5e6f648e30a9b934455aec14e00deafa70cc.jpg[/img]

During the events on Halloween night in SinisterHalloween® this all-new mental asylum chapter sends you into a new area within Mountain Peaks. As a journalist, you receive a secret email from the local asylum and a little girl is reported lost trick or treating. You decide to investigate the area.

Enter the mental asylum, with years of experience seeking the truth, use your wits, nerve, and mental fortitude to uncover the horrifying secrets within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/dfaeb73a0960aa310fa8ddd375fada9ed589a2b3.jpg[/img]

The interior reception area. It seems the emergency power is on. Why is the main power off? Something is not right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/76a36e0b561c7ef92a3b86a08a35b3a2275a7e2b.png[/img]
Where did the reception clerk go?

We have completed level design for the majority of the experience and are currently finalizing lighting.
We are hoping you can provide feedback to influence the final product. Head on over to our discord, and leave a msg, comment, and suggestion in our asylum channel.  https://discord.gg/7GeY56b

THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING SINISTER HALLOWEEN
Hi everyone, just wanted to thank all of you who purchased SHVR for supporting our continued development.


CONTINUING SUPPORT
It's been a week since we released Early Access. We have been paying attention to the forums and have been creating an Update Fix List.  This will be posted this weekend, so any concerns or suggestion you have please post in the appropriate discussion forum.

We have been developing SHVR for two years now. And we are not taking a break now that we have released. There is allot of work to do, and priority will be to release patches to fix bugs and to deal your concerns.

To keep you updated please follow 
https://twitter.com/HalloweenVRGame


DEVELOPING MAPS
Second Priority is to continuing further development. Including more maps, and features. 

Currently we are working on the Luxury Mansion Map. This map was release but unfinished. Screenshots and Video Clips will be coming over the next couple weeks to keep you updated with progress.


Again, thank you for supporting a first of a kind Halloween Horror VR game concept. Let's make this a popular game genre cause we love Halloween and cant wait to see the game completed for Halloween next year nice and early so we can celebrate it at Halloween events/parties.
